issuer: the Public Service Agency of the Ministry of Internal Affairs (შსს მომსახურების სააგენტო)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on sa.gov.ge, the Ministry of Internal Affairs' Service Agency. Its page on ages gives category B from 17; its page on terms says a licence for categories AM, A, B, BE, T, S, A1, A2 and B1 is valid for 15 years, renewed without a test on a medical certificate. The licence's fee wasn't read on a page reached, so it is null. The tests aren't held. The identity card is the ids engine's. On 2026-11-03 sa.gov.ge answered every page, its home page too, with a server error (HTTP 500, to curl and to a browser alike), and the Wayback Machine refused the connection; Common Crawl's copies of the age page (10 October 2026) and of the term page (5 September 2026) still say what is quoted, so the dates of reading stay 2026-10-30.
